subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca0324a95defa670cc38b324977134c93c44e5bf00eba51c7b2d171d3b3f93be.png]
solution:
The logic follows here is :

There are three inner figures which are changing positions, a circle, a triangle and a darkened asterisk/star sign.

→ The darkened asterisk sign moves one position left and then back to it's original position again in the next step and this repeats. 

→ The circle moves by one position in an anticlockwise direction in each step. 

→ The triangle moves by in an anticlockwise direction by one position in the first step, by two positions in the second, by three positions in the third and so on. 

So, the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e25c1ee1cb1d9ca37d657db1307415e7a46069a1a5d0ac5ed8e9db1886e40c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dbdb741bf9a3e837f9f13b69aa950d00fc53e776df2c2293b64b8a895cf7c39.png] 

Thus, the figure in option(1) will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
